auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Manage your menu from your phone.
auth.phoneHint: We'll send you a 6-digit code by SMS.
auth.devHint: Development: the code is printed in the server terminal.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Ugandan phone number, like 0772 123 456.
errors.phoneCountry: SMS codes only go to Ugandan numbers. Use email instead.
errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the message and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.smsFailed: We couldn't send the SMS right now. Try again, or use email instead.
errors.emailFailed: We couldn't send the email right now. Please try again.

sms.signInCode: Your {brand} code is {code}. It expires in 5 minutes.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.bodyOwner: You've been invited to manage {restaurant} on {brand}.
invite.bodyStaff: You've been invited to help at {restaurant} on {brand}.
invite.phoneHint: Sign in with the phone number ending in {digits}.
invite.expired: This invite has expired. Ask for a new one.
invite.revoked: This invite was cancelled. Ask for a new one.
invite.accepted: This invite has already been used. Sign in to continue.
invite.notFound: This invite link isn't valid. Check you copied all of it.

dashboard.title: Your restaurants
dashboard.noneBody: If someone from {brand} set up your menu, ask them to send you a sign-in link. Use the phone number they have for you.
dashboard.comingSoon: Menu editing, tables and QR codes are being added here next.

admin.title: Admin

create.title: New restaurant
create.intro: Create the restaurant, then send the owner their sign-in link on WhatsApp.
create.name: Restaurant name
create.whatsappHint: Orders from the menu go to this number.
create.ownerPhoneHint: They sign in with this number.
create.ownerEmailHint: Only if they prefer email sign-in.
create.trialDaysHint: Standard plan trial. 0 starts them on Free.

errors.name: Enter the restaurant's name (at least 2 letters).
errors.area: Enter the area, like Ntinda or Kira.
errors.whatsapp: Enter a valid WhatsApp number, like 0772 123 456.
errors.ownerPhone: Enter a valid phone number for the owner.
errors.ownerEmail: Enter a valid email for the owner.
errors.ownerContact: Add the owner's phone number (or email) so they can sign in.
errors.trialDays: Trial days must be between 0 and 365.
errors.agentCode: No active agent has that code.
errors.failed: The restaurant could not be created. Please try again.

created.title: {restaurant} is ready
created.body: Send the owner their sign-in link. It works once and expires in 14 days.

admin.inviteMessage:
Hello {name}! Your {brand} menu for {restaurant} is ready: {menuUrl}

To make changes, sign in here with this number ({phone}): {inviteUrl}
admin.inviteMessageEmail:
Hello {name}! Your {brand} menu for {restaurant} is ready: {menuUrl}

To make changes, sign in here with your email ({email}): {inviteUrl}

detail.newInviteHint: Makes a new link and cancels the old one.

home.intro: A QR menu for restaurants, cafés, lounges and bars. Diners scan, see your menu and order on WhatsApp.

diner.metaDescription: See the menu at {restaurant}{inArea}: {dishes}. Prices in UGX. Order on WhatsApp.
diner.emptyOrder: Nothing here yet. Tap a dish to add it.
diner.tableHint: From the QR code on your table.
diner.fallbackBody: Copy your order and send it on WhatsApp or by SMS to {phone}, or show it to a waiter.
diner.demoOrderTitle: This is the message the restaurant would get
diner.demoBanner: Demo menu: orders are not sent anywhere.
diner.demoNoContact: This is a demo menu, so calls and messages are turned off.
diner.notFoundBody: This menu link isn't working. Please ask a waiter for help.
diner.emptyMenu: The menu is being added. Please check back soon.
diner.offline: You're offline. This is the menu saved on your phone.

print.tagline: No app needed · Order on WhatsApp
print.taglineView: No app needed · See prices and photos

qr.title: QR codes
qr.intro: Print these and put them on your tables. Each code opens your menu; table codes also tell you which table ordered.
qr.wholeRestaurantHint: For the door, the counter or social media. No table number.
qr.noTables: No tables yet. Tables are added in the dashboard.
qr.freePlan: On the Free plan you get one QR code for the whole restaurant. Upgrade to Standard for a code on every table.
qr.tentsHint: One A4 page per table. Fold along the dashed line.
qr.stickersHint: Six stickers on each A4 sheet. Cut along the dashed lines.
